description:

Whether you’re sipping something cold, catching a live act, or just easing into the weekend sun, Happy Fridays is your excuse to clock out early and vibe out under the open sky.

Each week brings a new twist: DJs on deck, cheap drinks, pop-ups, games, slushies, and the occasional curveball. No two Fridays are alike — just reliably good.

name: BIO BIO @ HAVEN
description:
Bio Bio — Open Air Cinema at Haven 🎦🍿

This summer, Haven transforms into a backyard cinema under the sky 🌃 Welcome to Bio Bio — our new open-air film series where we’re screening cult classics, hidden gems, and unforgettable stories for free.

We’ve set the scene with a big screen, cozy seating, and a brand new popcorn machine ready to fire. The bar will be open, the evenings long, and the atmosphere casual — come by solo, with friends, or drop in midway through. 
It’s cinema without the rules, just how we like it.


UPCOMING DATES

📽️ May 21 | 17 - 00
Pusher I–III (Nicolas Winding Refn)
Our first night is Wednesday, May 21, and we’re kicking things off with a bang — all three films in Nicolas Winding Refn’s Pusher Trilogy. Raw, gritty, and iconic, these films helped define the Danish crime genre and launched Mads Mikkelsen's career.
Please note: These films contain graphic violence and are recommended for ages 15 and up.
__________

📽️ June 11
Valhalla (1986) vs Valhalla (2019)
Two films. One myth.
For the second edition of Bio Bio, we travel from Midgård to Asgård in the company of Thor, Loke, and two mortal children: Tjalfe and Røskva. First in the 1986 animated cult classic based on Peter Madsen’s beloved comics — then in Fenar Ahmad’s 2019 reimagining, where the gods are falling, and belief is breaking apart.
It’s a story about giants, goats, cosmic mischief, and the quiet power of ordinary mortals — told in two very different cinematic languages, across more than 30 years of Danish film history.
__________

📽️ June 25 |
Gammel Dansk
This Wednesday, we’re heading back to the good old Danish days — or were they really that great? Join us under the summer sky for a nostalgic comedy double feature, packed with commune dreams and crumbling fishing empires.

To help ease the flashbacks, we’ll be serving 𝑑𝑒𝑙𝑖𝑐𝑖𝑜𝑢𝑠 Gammel Dansk — the kind of shot people actually drank in the 70s and 80s, before we figured out alcohol could taste nice.

🎞 Det Store Flip (1997)
Copenhagen, 1972. Christoffer’s parents dive headfirst into hippie life with hash, communes, and Marx — much to his teenage dismay. 

🎞 Bornholms Stemme (1999)
Early 1980s Bornholm. Captain Lars Erik rules the waves — until fishing quotas and shifting tides threaten everything the island’s fishing kings hold dear.

Det Store Flip will feature English subtitles.

name: Hangaren x Culture Box: Mira (DE), Tim Andresen, MiniMalene, Rexie Lex, GÆO
description:
Mira is that rare kind of DJ whose music can immediately transport you into her world—a place of endless curiosity and deep, sensual groove. Mira has been at the height of her game for the past twenty years, continuously shaping the sounds around her and never ceasing to push and inspire new artists. As happy playing in a small underground club in East Germany in the ’90s as she is playing to thousands of festival-goers at some of today’s biggest festivals, Mira is truly one of those artists who can be said to do it for the love of the music. Every time a new track by an undiscovered producer falls into her lap, it’s a new moment for her to fall in love with her craft all over again—and to share that love with the tens of thousands who hear her play.

name: IMPURITY [BR] & GOAT SEMEN [PERU] (DEATH/METAL/BLACK/THRASH)
description:
Join us for, arguably, one of the heaviest shows of 2025!!! Unleashing total war we have IMPURITY and GOAT SEMEN!!

IMPURITY emerged from the depths of Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais, Brazil in 1989 where other notable bands such as Sarcófago, Sepultura, Mutilator, Holocausto resided in the mid-80s. Influenced by old black death metal bands such as Venom, Celtic Frost, Hellhammer they set out creating their own unholy noise over 30 years ago.

https://impurity.bandcamp.com/
https://www.facebook.com/impuritybrasil
https://www.instagram.com/impurityoficial.666

Much like the name, GOAT SEMEN is one of the most extreme bands in living memory.Formed in Lima, Peru in 2000 Goat Semen would quickly become one of South America’s most coveted metal exports with the release of its demos South American Terrorist Black Death Destruction (2000), Goat Semen (2003) and the universally praised Devotos del Diablo, a split release with Anal Vomit.
The band’s sound is as much a product of its influences as its surroundings. The ‘Warfare Noise’ of bands like Sarcofago, Holocausto and Chakal would combine with Blasphemy, Beherit and Hellhammer to channel the realities of growing up in the middle of a violent civil war. The incessant battery, the lacerating guitars, bomb sirens and rabid wails of vocalist Erick Neyra create a sense of shellshock and authenticity unmatched by other bands in their genre.

description:
MYCELIUM x Space Trax @ Den Anden Side

Saturday, July 19 │ Soft Selection │ Trance, Psytrance

————

Space Trax is back at Den Anden Side, continuing their showcase series with labelheads Frank Heise and Philipp Drube, joined by locals FILTH.y and DJ Bondefar!

https://on.soundcloud.com/bcB1uAL2EoPCdcrsls


DJ BONDEFAR
Significantly involved in Copenhagens psychedelic landscape, as co-founder of label Valis Copenhagen, member of the BunkerBauer collective, and half of Lund&Rønde.
I prefer a good read through trance history, digging deep into the forgotten corners of 90s goa while still supporting the fresh psychedelic creations.

FRANK HEISE
Frank Heise is a DJ and producer from Berlin, Germany and co-founder of the label Space Trax. He focuses on a sound that lies between hypnotic techno and psy-trance. With releases on Space Trax and Union Trance Mission, he has played at renowned Berlin venues such as Säule (Berghain) and RSO, as well as several cities across Europe including Copenhagen, Zurich, Warsaw, Yerevan, and Istanbul.

PHILIPP DRUBE
Originally rooted in Hamburg’s underground scene, Philipp Drube started to play gigs around 2011 before relocating to Berlin in 2013. From 2015 to 2020, he held a residency at Ismus and in 2018 founded the label Space Trax with fellow Frank Heise.
His sets focus on different faces of Trance and have lead to appearances at Berlin’s most established clubs such as Säule (Berghain), Griessmühle/RSO, or Tresor, as well as series like Mala Junta or Synoid, and continuous bookings around the world.

MYCELIUM
Mycelium is the underground network that forms the root system of fungi. It absorbs nutrients from the environment and sends electrical signals to mushrooms, functioning similarly to the human brain. Through a series of events, Den Anden Side aims to grow an underground network that connects the creative energies we see emerging across the globe. We hope our mycelium network can thrive in the soil of electronic music and provide nutrients to all the little fungi on the scene.

name: Hej Krop: Bevægelse og udstræk (Hi' Body: Movement and stretching)
description:
*english below

TILMELDING: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfotIwALMlwnVBgW04ufNiFxgCC4oNj8yNRAIPs2X-4mQ0P9w/viewform?usp=dialog

Kom med til en times rolig, men dynamisk bevægelse. Formålet er at skabe velvære, reducere angst og stress, få varmet kroppen op og strukket ud i musklerne.
Timen blander elementer fra fleksibilitets- og mobilitetstræning (bl.a yoga og somatisk træning) samt øvelser, der stimulerer det parasympatiske nervesystem og øger din forbindelse til kroppen.
Til Hej Krop mødes vi ikke for at tabe os eller se ud på en særlig måde, og Andrea som underviser er meget interesseret i at øve sig i at tilpasse øvelserne til folk med store, lange eller tykke kroppe, samt folk med kroniske lidelser og handicap.

Timen er på begynder-niveau, men fordi vi alle er forskellige kan det sagtens ske, at der er et par øvelser nogle ikke kan udføre. 

Hvis du har spørgsmål til timen eller har nogle behov som du gerne vil have tilgodeset så kontakt underviseren på: 
andreastorgaardbrok@gmail.com

Det er gratis at deltage og undervisningen foregår enten på dansk eller engelsk afhængigt af deltagernes behov. Holdet tager ca 1 time, vi hjælpes ad med at rydde op. 

Om instruktøren: 
Andrea er har dyrket yoga, styrke- og fleksibilitetstræning i over ti år. Hun har (endnu) ikke en uddannelse i bevægelse, men er nysgerrig på kroppen og god til at lære fra sig. Til daglig er hun sygeplejerske og hundemor, og trænger tit til at få strukket ud og trukket vejret.


Tilmelding foregår via mail, du får tilsendt en bekræftelse når din tilmelding er gået igennem, samt info om hvordan du kommer frem til LGBT+ medborgerhuset. 

//

SIGN UP: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfotIwALMlwnVBgW04ufNiFxgCC4oNj8yNRAIPs2X-4mQ0P9w/viewform?usp=dialog

Join for an hour of calm, yet dynamic movement. The purpose is to create wellbeing, reduce anxiety and stress, warm up the body, and stretch the muscles. The class blends elements from flexibility and mobility training (including yoga and somatic training) as well as exercises that stimulate the parasympathetic nervous system and enhance your connection to the body. At Hej Krop, we do not meet to lose weight or to look a certain way, and Andrea, the instructor, is very interested in trying to adapt the exercises for individuals with large, long, or fat bodies, as well as people with chronic conditions and disabilities. 

The class is at a beginner level, but since we are all different, it may happen that there are a few exercises that some cannot perform.

If you have questions about the class or have certain needs that you would like to have addressed, please contact the instructor at: andreastorgaardbrok@gmail.com.

Participation is free, and the teaching takes place either in Danish or English depending on the participants' needs. The session lasts about 1 hour, and we will help each other with the cleanup.

About the instructor: Andrea has practiced yoga, strength, and flexibility training for over ten years. She does not (yet) have a degree in movement, but she is curious about the body and good at teaching. In her daily life, she is a nurse and a dog mom, and often needs to stretch out and take a breath. 

Registration is done via email, and you will receive a confirmation when your registration has gone through, as well as information on how to get to the LGBT+ community center.

name: Big City Nights: Film + forfriskninger i Himmelbio  // Juli - september 2025
description:
Big City Nights: Film + forfriskninger i Himmelbio

New York – Berlin – Hongkong – Paris – Tokyo – Rom – Oslo – København

Over byen og i hjertet af København inviterer vi på sanserejse til en række af verdens metropoler. 

Byer har altid spillet en central rolle i filmens verden – fra New Yorks glitrende skyline til Tokyos neon og Berlins kant. Med 'Big City Nights' udforsker vi markante byer gennem film, der ikke blot viser de fysiske landskaber, men også de psykologiske og sociale dynamikker. Her handler det om at mærke en bys sjæl – dens atmosfære, dens mennesker og den måde, de påvirker hinanden på.

Vi dykker ned i ikoniske såvel som mindre kendte metropoler og ser på, hvordan stederne præger både filmskaberne og deres karakterer. Filmene bliver i sig selv et vindue til byens energi, kultur og kontraster. 

Serien præsenteres i samarbejde med Copenhagen Architecture Forum og med støtte fra en række ambassader og kulturcentre. 

BEMÆRK: Vi sørger for en forfriskning, der matcher filmens eller byens ånd; den er inkluderet i billetten og serveres fem minutter før filmstart lige ved indgangen til Himmelbio – og tages med ind til filmen.

Forestillingen er udendørs, så klæd dig efter vejret for den bedste oplevelse. Vi har også et tæppe, du kan låne. 

Billetter: https://www.dfi.dk/cinemateket/biograf/filmserier/serie/27979
